PARK SMART • A Guide to Parking Laws
NOT ON FOG LINE

NO PARKING a vehicle for more than 24
hours on either side of a public street within
the same block. Vehicles must move to a
different block every 24 hours. (BCC 11.23.020)
NO PARKING in a fire lane (BCC 23.11.503)
Vehicles parked on a street with an expired
registration of more than 45 days may be
towed at the owner’s expense. (RCW 46.55.113)
NO PARKING with a “For Sale” sign in the
vehicle (WAC 308-330-436)
NO PARKING when “No Parking Anytime”
or time limit restrictions are present (RCW
46.61.570)
NO PARKING within 5 feet from a driveway
